blurb: Blackberry Farm Golf Course offers golf play with different rates for residents and non-residents, including weekday and weekend pricing. They have a Juniors Only Program affiliated with the Northern California Golf Association’s Youth on Course program. The course operates from dawn to dark with specific holiday hours and rates.
